newsitem.title: FRANCE: Le Pen under egg bombardement in Paris suburb.
newsitem.headline: Le Pen under egg bombardement in Paris suburb.

text.p: Anti-racist militants hurled eggs and stones at extreme-rightist leader Jean-Marie Le Pen when he toured a troubled Paris suburb on Friday where his daughter is a candidate in France's parliamentary election.

Eyewitnesses said several dozen members of the "Ras-le-Front" (Enough of the Front) group shouted insults at Le Pen when he arrived at Mantes-la-Jolie two days before the decisive National Assembly runoffs.
Bodyguards and police formed a barrier to protect the head of the National Front party from stones and eggs, none of which apparently hit Le Pen.
Le Pen, who had to take refuge in a cafe, was apparently not hurt but was heard to be shouting angrily: "When I'm attacked, I've never been afraid of another man or even several at once."
As a student leader in the late 1940s and early 1950s, Le Pen was well known as a brawler and leader of violent street demonstrations.
